answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 17 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 470 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The vine test is the live device, the thread test is the locked stake, and the orchard test is the graded history no template can fake.
